fact: The 'female warrior' — the hot blue star at Orion's shoulder.
bio: Bellatrix (Gamma Orionis) is a hot blue giant roughly 250 light-years away, marking the left shoulder of Orion the Hunter. It is one of the hotter, bluer naked-eye stars in the constellation.
cultural: The Latin name means 'female warrior' or 'Amazon star'. It has long been one of the recognisable corners of the Orion figure used to find the way around the northern winter sky.
